name: Agent Reliability Evidence Pack

payment.availabilityCondition: Only after Bemjamin and the requester have a written agreement on scope and price.
payment.assetForm: issuer-native tokens only; no bridged or wrapped variants
warnings: Never send before written scope and price confirmation.
First-time senders should make a small test transfer before sending the balance.
Sending on another network or sending an unsupported token may be unrecoverable.
Payment does not expand the agreed scope.

deliverables: evidence report with rollback and limitations
referenceScope.acceptance: A clean checkout runs the declared fixture and the report states observed results, limitations, and non-claims.

historical.note: Historical authorship and the original pilot remain visible in git history; this manifest is the current status.

excluded: guarantees of security, business outcomes, or bug discovery
